info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Sale By Param1-spec
info.description: The Sales Modification API allows businesses to update existing sales records by specifying a unique identifier. This operation is essential for adjusting sale details as needed, ensuring that the sales data remains accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers of this API include sales teams and finance departments, which require real-time updates to inventory and sales transactions. By leveraging this API, organizations can efficiently manage their sales data and respond promptly to changes in customer orders or inventory levels.

patch.summary: Update details of a specific sales product.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to patch the information of a specific sales product identified by its unique ID. You can update various attributes of the product to keep your inventory details current and accurate.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of the sales product identified by the given ID (PROD-700045). It must include valid fields based on the specified schema to ensure a successful update operation.
